question: Who is the 20th governor of Uttar Pradesh since 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anandiben Patel**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Anandiben Patel** became the **20th Governor of Uttar Pradesh** in **2019**. She assumed office on **July 29, 2019**, succeeding Ram Naik. 
• She is the first woman to serve as the **Governor of Uttar Pradesh**, the most populous state in India. 
• Before her appointment as Governor of Uttar Pradesh, Anandiben Patel served as the **Governor of Madhya Pradesh** (January 2018 - July 2019) and held additional charge of Chhattisgarh for a brief period. 
• Anandiben Patel is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and was previously the **Chief Minister of Gujarat** from **May 2014 to August 2016**. 
• She has been recognized for her contributions to women's empowerment, education, and rural development during her political career. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Governorship in India:** 
• The **Governor** is the constitutional head of a state in India, appointed by the **President of India** under **Article 155** of the Indian Constitution. 
• The Governor serves a term of **five years**, but they hold office at the pleasure of the President. 
• The primary duties of a Governor include administering the oath of office to the Chief Minister and other state ministers, approving bills passed by the state legislature, and overseeing the state's administration. 
• **Anandiben Patel's Career:** 
• Anandiben Patel was born on **November 21, 1941**, in Gujarat, India. 
• She has been a prominent leader in the BJP and began her political career in 1987. 
• She is known for her work in the fields of **education, women's empowerment, and rural development**. 
• As Chief Minister of Gujarat, she focused on initiatives like **Gatisheel Gujarat** and improving maternal health through **Chiranjeevi Yojana**. 
• **Other Governors of Uttar Pradesh:** 
• Notable Governors of Uttar Pradesh include **Ram Naik** (2014–2019), **Banwari Lal Joshi** (2009–2014), and **Motilal Vora** (1993–1996). 
• Each Governor played a significant role in the administration and governance of the state. 
• **Functions of the Governor:** 
• Acts as the **constitutional head** of the state and ensures compliance with the Constitution of India. 
• Appoints the **Chief Minister** and other members of the Council of Ministers. 
• Has the power to dissolve the **Legislative Assembly** and recommend President's Rule in case of administrative failure. 
• Gives assent to bills, withholds assent, or reserves bills for the President's consideration. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Significance of Women Governors:** 
• Anandiben Patel's appointment as the first female Governor of Uttar Pradesh symbolizes progress toward **gender equality** in Indian politics. 
• Other prominent women Governors in India include **Sarojini Naidu**, the first woman Governor of an Indian state (Uttar Pradesh, 1947), and **Margaret Alva** (Governor of Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Goa, and Gujarat). 
• **Governance in Uttar Pradesh:** 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India, with a **population of over 200 million**, making the role of the Governor particularly significant. 
• The state plays a crucial role in Indian politics, with the highest number of seats in the **Lok Sabha (80)** and **Rajya Sabha (31)**.
